readings.Aries: Your instinct to protect the people around you is real. Make sure they know it's protection and not control. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Taurus: Slowness is a form of intelligence. The world will argue otherwise. You are correct. The first instinct was right.
readings.Gemini: There's a feeling underneath the thinking. Stop analysing it long enough to feel it. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Cancer: The feelings that seem too large to speak are usually smaller once they have words. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Leo: Something you've been holding as a personal failure is a shared one. Stop carrying it alone. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Virgo: Something you noticed and catalogued weeks ago is relevant now. Your records are good. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Libra: The beauty you seek in your environment is also something you create in everyone around you. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: You are drawn to what frightens you. This is why you understand things others don't. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Sagittarius: The future you're planning for is being built in the choices you're making now. Check the alignment. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Capricorn: The ambition is not the problem. The sacrifice it's requiring is worth looking at honestly. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Aquarius: You have been right about this for a long time. It is not yet time to say 'I told you so.' One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Pisces: Someone's pain has become your pain. This is your nature. Also: you are allowed to put it down. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
